pages.title: Starting From Scratch
pages.text: $(o)"I've only been in this world for a short while but have already encountered numerous creatures that didn't seem like the most friendly kind.$(br2)Using some of the rocks and reeds i found everywhere, i managed to hollow out one of these large trees for much needed shelter."
$(o)Luckily i know how to make a crude axe out of some $(l:survival_guide/01/sticks)sticks$() and pebbles, wrapped in reeds.
